title: After the launch flow, Vera drafts the Space copy, website words, Spotlight and first email from the person's own words, every field cited

source.ref: Vera guided launch, owner ruling 2026-10-29: built from what they submitted, quoting their words, never invented; cost-capped AI.

verify.note: Runs the deterministic builder with no AI call and checks every cite is a verbatim quote from the source it names, a forged cite empties its field, and the wiring (envFlag switch, two calls per launch, Haiku under the launch-buildout daily cap, no persona, wellness, Journey or Circle data). Fails on main, where there is no buildout.

detail: lib/launch/buildout.ts is the shared contract (BuildoutDraft, BuildoutCite) lane F's review screen imports. Draft stored in space_launch.buildout jsonb (migration 20270346027400, applied before merge, ADR-1111) because steps jsonb is capped and normalizeSteps drops unknown keys. Not here: the review screen, publishing the draft, sending the email.
